title: Potteries Thinkbelt
body: Price adopted the advancement of science and engineering working with industry as core content for his scheme – the integration of manufacturing and learning – but, took the challenge of changing attitudes towards education a step further. The opening statement of the publication of his project in New Society opens with: “Higher education and further education should become a major industrial undertaking, not a service run by gentlemen for the few.” His ‘Thinkbelt’ – the neologism alone asks that we free up preconceptions of the typology - goes beyond both the traditional monastic form of “polite cathedral town amenity” and the then current trend for building huge new campus’s on isolated greenfield sites.
